peak_hours: 05:00 AM dawn during Vaikuntha Ekadashi (Uttara Dwara Darshanam)
festival_crowds: Sri Rama Navami Kalyanotsavam: Devotees gather at the Mithila Stadium to witness the celestial wedding of Lord Rama and Sita.
Vaikuntha Ekadashi (Mukkoti Ekadashi): Pilgrims visit to pass through the Uttara Dwara (Northern Gate) at dawn.
Karthika Masam: Devotees perform special prayers and light lamps along the Godavari River banks, creating significant weekend crowds.
tips: Barricaded Queue Compartments: Steel queue corridors regulate devotee traffic, with temporary holding compartments providing drinking water and seating during peak festivals.
Token Systems: Barcode and physical slot tokens are distributed during large-scale festivals to systematically stagger entry times and control crowd density.
Darshan Waiting Times: General free Sarva Darshan queues take roughly 1 hour on normal weekdays, scaling up to several hours during core festival seasons.
Police Deployment: Extensive local police contingents secure the temple parameters, Mithila Stadium grounds, and Godavari bathing ghats during major events.
Godavari Bathing Arrangements: Certified lifeguards, divers, patrol boats, and safety lifebuoys are deployed at the riverbanks during peak festival seasons.
Medical Camps: Temporary medical response tents are erected near Mithila Stadium and the riverbanks to manage emergency healthcare and distribute hydration packets.
Shuttle Services: Private vehicles face restrictions at town boundaries during major festivals, with the state transit corporation running dedicated pilgrim shuttle buses.
Public Announcement (PA) Systems: High-power PA systems across the shrine complex, stadium, and riverbanks broadcast safety updates and direct foot traffic.
Special Entry Darshan: Paid speed queue ticket options are available at the counter for ₹50 and ₹100 to bypass standard free lines.
VIP Break Darshan: Dedicated VIP Break Darshan access is available at a fixed tier of ₹250 per individual during specific management windows.
Antaralaya Abhishekam: The premium Sunday morning ritual requires a specialized ticket tier priced officially at ₹500.
